title: Composition isomorphism for $Lf^*$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}$
statement:
For morphisms $f\colon X\to Y$ and $g\colon Y\to Z$ of the setting and a commutative condensed
ring $\Lambda$, the *composition isomorphism*

$$
L(g\circ f)^*\cong Lf^*\circ Lg^*\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(Z,\Lambda)\to D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Lambda)
$$

of the restricted pullbacks of [def-sfb-dc-upper-star] is the unique natural isomorphism whose
image under the inclusion into $D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$ is the ambient composition isomorphism.

proof.text:
The restricted functors commute with the inclusions ([def-sfb-dc-upper-star]). So the ambient
composition isomorphism $L(g\circ f)^*\cong Lf^*\circ Lg^*$
([sk-prop-sfb-module-derived-factorization]), restricted to bounded constructible complexes,
becomes an isomorphism between $\iota\circ L(g\circ f)^*$ and $\iota\circ Lf^*\circ Lg^*$. Since the
inclusion $\iota$ is fully faithful, this isomorphism has a unique preimage.
